# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_with_pool", value=filtered_hotels)

# Retrieve the latest restaurant results with Norwegian cuisine, rating >= 3.5, and budget <= 50

# Filter restaurants for Norwegian cuisine, rating >= 3.5, and budget <= 50
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(prior_results=restaurants, cuisine=["Norwegian"], rating=[3.5, 5.0], budget=50)

# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants_norwegian", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, restaurants=filtered_restaurants, groupBy="restaurant")

# Save the nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants_to_hotels", value=nearest_restaurants)

# Output the summary
print("No planning needed")
